in_marathi.name: Kanvraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sacred Forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanvraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Kan’ (Lord) and ‘Vrishabh’ (Sacred Forest), the name ‘Kanvraj’ is a revered name in Hindu culture. The lord of the sacred forest is often considered the protector of the forest and its inhabitants, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and a deep connection to nature.

The lord of the sacred forest is often considered the protector of the forest and its inhabitants, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and a deep connection to nature.
